description:
Cast Chain of Plasma by paying {1}{R}, targeting Stuffy Doll.
Ashling triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw a card.
Resolve Chain of Plasma, dealing 3 damage to Stuffy Doll and choosing to discard a card to copy it.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 3 damage to the chosen player.
Repeat from step 2 (getting Ashling's additional results once each).
